mechanism: Etanercept (TNF inhibitor) may increase methotrexate toxicity when used concurrently; folic acid supplementation is indicated to mitigate methotrexate-related folate depletion in combination DMARD therapy.
action: Folic acid supplementation (1 mg daily or 5 mg weekly) is recommended when etanercept is combined with methotrexate to reduce toxicity; monitor CBC and liver function.
